scripts.name: Rival
scripts.shows: Hand in a pocket, then reaches the other hand out at you as a challenge.
scripts.moves: Calm: holds pose 1, slides a little and switches to pose 2, ends holding pose 3.

scripts.name: Falkner
scripts.shows: Battle stance: bends forward and swings an arm out like a wing.
scripts.moves: Darts forward, switches pose and slides back, ends leaning back.

scripts.name: Bugsy
scripts.shows: Swings a net up and forward over the head.
scripts.moves: Holds, leans back a little, then two quick pose switches with a small push forward.

scripts.name: Whitney
scripts.shows: Jumps happily into the air with the arms up.
scripts.moves: Lively: several small hops and one big jump straight up, ends with small jerks.

scripts.name: Morty
scripts.shows: Reaches a hand out, turns away and pulls the scarf up over the face.
scripts.moves: Played backwards (3, 2, 1): a long pause, a small jerk, ends in pose 1.

scripts.name: Pryce
scripts.shows: Stands firm on a cane while an icy wind blows the scarf.
scripts.moves: Flutter: switches fast between poses 2 and 3, slower, faster, slower. No moving.

scripts.name: Jasmine
scripts.shows: Stands shy and still, looks down and folds the hands.
scripts.moves: Slow and calm: a long pause, slides gently, switches pose and ends calmly.

scripts.name: Chuck
scripts.shows: Crouches in a battle stance and flexes with a fist up.
scripts.moves: Shakes back and forth for a second, a hard push forward, then small hops.

scripts.name: Clair
scripts.shows: Turns so the cape swirls and looks at you over the shoulder.
scripts.moves: Slides in from the side and back again while the pose changes: a side step.

scripts.name: Giovanni with his hat
scripts.shows: Holds a hat, puts it on and tips it.
scripts.moves: A long pause, a jerk forward and a pose switch, ends with quick small shivers.

scripts.name: Elite Four woman (orange hair)
scripts.shows: Raises a hand to the face, a Poke Ball ready in the other.
scripts.moves: A long pause, a small push, a quick shiver, then a slow sway before it holds.

scripts.name: Lance
scripts.shows: Flings the cape out with the arms spread: a dramatic entrance.
scripts.moves: Slides a little, switches pose, a short shiver, holds.

scripts.name: Agatha
scripts.shows: Leans calmly on a cane and lifts it a little.
scripts.moves: Four poses: starts in pose 4, pushed forward and slides back while the poses change.

scripts.name: Tower Tycoon
scripts.shows: The coat flutters while bending the knees and clenching the fists (5 poses).
scripts.moves: Switches calmly between two poses four times, then shakes between two others and ends in a big pose.

scripts.name: Brock
scripts.shows: Crouches, clenches a fist and looks up.
scripts.moves: Short: quickly through three poses with a small jerk, then holds the last one long.

scripts.name: Hall Matron
scripts.shows: A hand over the eyes, looking out, several small steps (6 poses).
scripts.moves: Six poses in a row with long pauses and small side shifts, ends in the last pose.

scripts.name: Factory Head
scripts.shows: Shows a card, then puts a hand on the hip (5 poses).
scripts.moves: Five poses played backwards: two calm, then three fast, ends in pose 1.

scripts.name: Misty
scripts.shows: A sporty jump and kick, lands with the arms out.
scripts.moves: Jump: two poses, a jump up and down, lands with a small tip and slides back a little.

scripts.name: Lt. Surge
scripts.shows: Throws off the sunglasses and crosses the arms.
scripts.moves: A long pause, bobs 1 px up and down four times, then pose 3 with a small push.

scripts.name: Erika
scripts.shows: Turns calmly in a kimono and smiles (4 poses).
scripts.moves: Slides calmly to the side and back through two poses, then pose 3 and back to 2.

scripts.name: Sabrina
scripts.shows: Moves a hand from the face and stretches it out, like telekinesis.
scripts.moves: A long pause, a small dip down and up, then poses 1 and 3 held long.

scripts.name: Blaine
scripts.shows: Lifts the hat and waves it.
scripts.moves: Simple: three poses one after another with pauses, back to the first. No moving.

scripts.name: Gold
scripts.shows: Pulls the cap down, almost standing still.
scripts.moves: Minimal: a long pause, a small jerk sideways, two short poses and back.

scripts.name: Blue
scripts.shows: Points at you, sure of himself.
scripts.moves: Switches slowly between two poses twice, slides forward and back, ends in pose 3.

scripts.name: Bruno
scripts.shows: Sits cross-legged and punches the fists together.
scripts.moves: Slides forward while the pose changes, then quick small jerks back and forth, holds.

scripts.name: Giovanni
scripts.shows: Throws a Poke Ball up in the air and catches it.
scripts.moves: Three poses, each held long: calm and slow, no moving.

scripts.name: Cynthia
scripts.shows: Stands with one hand raised, then the wind blows the long hair and the coat out to one side.
scripts.moves: Sways softly between two poses for four seconds, a pause, then turns into the windblown pose and holds it.

scripts.name: Bertha
scripts.shows: Holds a hand out, folds the hands at the chest, then chuckles with a hand at the mouth.
scripts.moves: Calm: a long pause, a short pose, then holds the last.

scripts.name: Flint
scripts.shows: Leans forward with a grin, then stands up laughing with the hands on the hips.
scripts.moves: Holds, laughs, bobs between two poses a few times and ends laughing.

scripts.name: Lucian
scripts.shows: Stands sideways, calm, lifts one hand and touches the face.
scripts.moves: A long pause, the hand comes up slowly, a tiny slide, then holds.

scripts.name: Cyrus
scripts.shows: Stands very still with the hands at the sides, then stretches one arm out with an open hand.
scripts.moves: Still for two seconds, a long pause, then a small step and the arm out.

scripts.name: Byron
scripts.shows: Swings one arm up over the shoulder with the cape flowing, then rests it there.
scripts.moves: A pause, the arm up, held, then a small push and it rests.

scripts.name: Candice
scripts.shows: Stands with the knees together, jumps up and cheers with a fist in the air.
scripts.moves: A long pause, a hop up and down, then holds the cheering pose.

scripts.name: Fantina
scripts.shows: Bows deeply, then sweeps an arm out like a dancer.
scripts.moves: A pause, a bow with a sway to the side, then the sweeping arm, held.

scripts.name: Gardenia
scripts.shows: Laughs with the hands near the face, skips with an arm out, then points at you.
scripts.moves: A long pause, a quick skip to the side and back, ends pointing.

scripts.name: Maylene
scripts.shows: Stretches high, drops into a low stance with clenched fists, then a wide fighting stance.
scripts.moves: Small fast sways while stretching, then the low stance, then the wide stance with a small shift.

scripts.name: Roark
scripts.shows: Points high up and forward, then puts a hand to the top of the head.
scripts.moves: Slides back a little in small steps while pointing, then the hand to the head.

scripts.name: Volkner
scripts.shows: Sits on the ground looking bored, gets up turned away, then stands and faces you.
scripts.moves: Sits for a second, gets up bent over, holds, then turns to you.

scripts.name: Wake
scripts.shows: Flexes with the fists together, stands with the chest out, then raises both fists and shouts.
scripts.moves: Pumps between two flexes several times, then a big flex, held.

scripts.name: Barry
scripts.shows: Bounces impatiently between a step and a jump, then stands with both fists up.
scripts.moves: Fast jittery bounces, a pause, then the fists-up pose.

scripts.name: Buck
scripts.shows: Puts an arm behind the head, then lunges forward with a fist out.
scripts.moves: Swings between two poses for a few seconds, then a fast lunge, held.

scripts.name: Cheryl
scripts.shows: Waves softly with one hand, then holds both hands shyly near the face.
scripts.moves: Slow: a pause, a gentle wave with small slides, ends shy.

scripts.name: Marley
scripts.shows: Stands quietly and tilts the head a little.
scripts.moves: Very calm: two long holds with one short change between them.

scripts.name: Mira
scripts.shows: Spins with the arms spread and skips with a knee up.
scripts.moves: Twirls back and forth through the poses three times, quick and bouncy.

scripts.name: Riley
scripts.shows: Holds the hat, flings an arm out to the side, then stretches it forward.
scripts.moves: The arm goes out, then a long fast shiver between two poses.
